original: We did all that running away from\nthe Numemon, I'm thirsty...
But we won't be lucky enough to\nfind drinks around here.
I never expected to find vending\nmachines here! There's so many!
Mimi, you're not thinking of\ngetting a drink, are you?
We're not gonna find juice just\nlike that!
Oh, well, she's still like a\nchild.
Hmph, this vending machine doesn't\nhave cola. I wanna drink cola!
This is great! I want some cola,\ntoo!
I'll give you all of it.
Yeah, it tastes better when you\ndon't drink it alone.
I'll let you have all of it.
You shouldn't give me all of it.
Don't worry! You're the youngest,\nafter all.
I really don't want to be treated\nlike that.
Cola, huh...I haven't had that in\na while.
I only have 100 yen at the moment.
Don't worry about me. It'd be bad\nform if I leeched off others.
I'm sorry! If I had more than 100\nyen on me, I'd buy more than one.
It's all right. You don't need to\nspend money on me.
It's very tasty! And it's\nrefreshing, too!
I'm more of a tea person.
Is that how you think of me?
How could anyone like tea more\nthan cola?
Doesn't look like there are any\nvending machines beyond here...
I can't walk, I'm still too\nthirsty!
I found it! There's a vending\nmachine! I'm gonna drink some\nbubbling, sparkling cola!
He's trying to hit on you, Mimi.\nWhat are you gonna do?
Definitely not! Why would I go out\nwith a thing like that?!
A thing? Why are you calling me a\nthing? Now I'm angry! Hey,\neveryone, let's attack her!
If we stay together, we'll just be\neasy targets for them!
Okay, we'll split up, run, and\nmeet up later! Let's go!
That's weird, I didn't even do\nanything yet...
Missy! Get over here and hide!
I am Toy Town's mayor. I love the\ntoys and they love me.
That's so cool! He must be a good\nDigimon!
It's a trick. He's been acting\nweird lately...for some reason.
He said "let's play together,\neveryone", so maybe everyone's in\nToy Town.
Are we going on a date in Toy\nTown?
It's not a date! We're going to\nlook for everyone!
Wow! It looks just like an\namusement park!
Mimi...You remember why we came\nhere, right?
Right...we were trying to meet up\nwith everyone.
Let's stay on track and look for\nthem!
Mimi! We won't find anything by\ngoing that way!
Taichi! I'm so glad you're okay!
This is fun, this is fun!
This isn't like you at all,\nYamato!
Mimi, something's got to be behind\nthis.
Sora! I'm so glad to see you here!
Why is Sora acting like this?
This is the best! This is\ndefinitely the best!
Why's he clapping like a machine?
Seems like he can't hear you.
Their Digimon should be with them,\nbut I haven't seen them at all...
Mimi, Monzaemon's a really strong\nDigimon! We have to run!
Time to erase the children's\nemotions and make them into toys\nfor the toys!
We've been waiting for you, miss.
What's with you!? I don't really\nget what happened, but you took\naway my friends' emotions, right?
We're here to save ya, missy!
Even though they can't do anything\nbut throw poop...
Even those dirty and spineless\nNumemon are helping her! I have to\nprotect Mimi, too! I...
Put 'em up! This is for Mimi and\nthe Numemon!
We got captured by Monzaemon, and\nhe locked us up.
Thoughtlessly throwing away toys\nafter getting bored of them...
So it was because of that gear,\nhuh?
Palmon, thank you for bringing my\nconceited heart back to its\nsenses.
Missy! Give me a kiss as your\nthanks!
Still as blunt as ever, I see...
